id_allocator.sql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(substr(id,2) AS INTEGER)),0)+1 FROM work_tasks WHERE workspace=:workspace AND substr(id,1,1)='T' AND length(id)>1 AND substr(id,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
id_allocator.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; read max numeric suffix for this workspace; insert next id; paired event; COMMIT. Roll back all on failure.
